name: mqdd_prio_5
oracle_ref: read-write lane isolation: BE_READ drains before BE_WRITE due to batching and last_dir=READ default
notes: Phase-3 re-spaced sectors (previously 0..64 with insert_count=14 vs trace 7 — 50% background at partition-scan sectors; empirically the 5 reads did NOT plug-merge, 5 separate INSERTs nr=8, but any count gate was noise-assisted). expected_merge corrected to false: 64-sector gaps make merges impossible (the previous true was stale and misleading). Batching<16 drains reads first (R2560..R2816 ascending C-LOOK), then writes (W5120,W5248). This remains a lane-priority test, NOT an ioprio test (ioprio_set via io_uring sqe does not propagate to request ioprio).
